personalInfo.name: Karthhic R Ponnalagi
personalInfo.title: R & D Engineer
personalInfo.profile: I’m an engineer driven by a passion for building, experimenting, and solving real-world problems. My interests span sensors, actuators, computer networking, and hands-on prototyping. I enjoy creating things in my own workshop, where I use a 3D printer and laser cutter to turn ideas into physical products for fun and learning. Professionally, I work in R&D, developing custom engineering and automation solutions based on customer requirements. I enjoy the challenge of understanding unique needs, finding practical solutions, and bringing concepts to life through design and implementation. Engineering is more than my profession — it’s something I genuinely enjoy and care deeply about.
